description: Transform layers or a path numerically, as Free Transform's options bar does: move, scale, rotate and skew (Edit > Transform > Skew) around a reference point; repeat the last transform (Edit > Transform > Again); or transform a duplicate, keeping the original. With path, transforms the path's points (Edit > Transform Path)

again.description: Repeat the last transform instead of giving values (Transform Again)

duplicate.description: Layers: transform a copy of each layer, placed above it. Default false

path.description: A path name (Paths panel) to transform instead of layers

target.description: Which layers to act on. Give ids (from list_layers or a create tool), names, or active: true. Each layer transforms around its own reference point

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

name: apply_transform
title: Apply Transform
